units.source_text: 虽然阿住拼命解释需要一个男人的各种理由，但是这些话连她自己都难以信服。

en.t: Although Ozumi desperately explained all sorts of reasons why she needed a man, even she herself found those words hard to believe.

units.source_text: 最主要的是她内心的真实想法——

en.t: What mattered most was what she truly thought deep down:

units.source_text: 她希望自己可以过得清闲日子的真实意图并未和盘托出。

en.t: she had not fully revealed her real wish to live an easy, idle life.

units.source_text: 阿民一眼就看穿了婆婆心里的想法，依旧咬着咸豌豆，一点都不客气的指责婆婆。

en.t: Otami saw straight through what the old woman was thinking, and still chewing salted peas, she accused her without the slightest courtesy.

units.source_text: 因为这样，阿住才明白，原来阿民是一个言辞犀利的人呢。

en.t: Because of this, Ozumi finally understood that Otami was in fact a sharp-tongued person.
